name: Omasweeper
author: Jankees
description: Minesweeper for omarchy-shell, drawn like a TUI: a character grid on hairlines, base-36 gutter labels, ANSI numbers and a status bar. Opens as an ordinary tiled window, plays entirely from the keyboard with vim motions, makes 8-bit noises, and unloads again when you close it. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle jankeesvw.omasweeper
